page_title: LYO 1-1 REI | Lyon v Reims 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Yehvann Diouf (Reims) leaps to collect the ball.
90+1' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) sees a yellow card from Thomas Leonard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

90' Anthony Lopes leaps like a salmon to deny Amir Richardson (Reims), whose effort is headed to the top left corner of the goal, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Reims are going to take it.
89' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) replaces Henrique.
89' Substitution. Christ-Emmanuel Letono Mbondi (Reims) replaces Oumar Diakite.
86' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Junya Ito (Reims) sends it out of play.
85' Malick Fofana (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
82' Junya Ito (Reims) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Amir Richardson.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maxime Busi (Reims) will replace Sergio Akieme.
81' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Foket (Reims) replacing Reda Khadra.

80' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Yehvann Diouf thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
78' The foul by Amir Richardson (Reims) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Leonard.
76' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Thomas Leonard lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
75' Mama Balde (Lyon) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
74' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Malick Fofana (Lyon) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
73' Substitution. Keito Nakamura makes his way off the pitch and Amir Richardson (Reims) comes on as his replacement.
72' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Valentin Atangana Edoa will be replaced by Amadou Kone (Reims).
72' Substitution. Gift Orban did his best and is replaced by Mama Balde (Lyon).
71' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
69' Oumar Diakite (Reims) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Leonard saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Lyon, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
69' Malick Fofana (Lyon) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
68' Gift Orban (Lyon) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

65' 1 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Said Benrahma finds Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Yehvann Diouf had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
63' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Here is a change. Nemanja Matic is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Said Benrahma (Lyon).
62' Substitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) has come on for Alexandre Lacazette.

61' Junya Ito (Reims) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
58' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
55' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. The ball rebounds to Joseph Okumu (Reims) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
55' Corner kick. Junya Ito (Reims) is ready to send the ball into the box.
55' The resulting corner from Junya Ito (Reims) is cleared by the opposition's defence. Reims have been awarded a corner kick.

54' He should have scored! Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Reims.
53' Junya Ito (Reims) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
52' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
50' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Junya Ito (Reims) offside.
47' The resulting corner from Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is cleared.
46' Pierre Sage makes a switch. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is coming on in place of Rayan Cherki at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
44' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
40' Thomas Leonard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) and blew his whistle.
39' Half-chance! Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) plays a pass into the box, but Yehvann Diouf reacts well to snuff out the attack.
38' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
38' Sergio Akieme (Reims) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. It will be a corner kick for Reims.
35' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

33' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
31' The ball possession at the moment is 66:34.

27' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
25' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends the corner into the box, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts it and averts the threat.
23' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
21' Henrique (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Reda Khadra (Reims) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
19' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner which is cleared.
18' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon). The ball is out of play and Lyon manage to earn a corner.
16' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
16' Oumar Diakite (Reims) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Anthony Lopes and he makes a comfortable save.
14' Reims are seeing far more of the ball now.
11' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Oumar Diakite (Reims), but Anthony Lopes is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
10' One of the players from Lyon times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

7' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
7' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
5' Keito Nakamura (Reims) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
4' Henrique (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Reims will kick-off.
Thomas Leonard was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
